title: Deepgram raises $130M at $1.3B valuation and buys a YC AI startup
description: Deepgram is raising its Series C round at a $1.3 billion valuation.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Slackbot is an AI agent now
description: Salesforce unveils Slackbot, a new AI agent that allows users to complete tasks across multiple enterprise applications from Slack.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Brazil orders Meta to suspend policy banning third-party AI chatbots from WhatsApp
description: Brazil's competition watchdog has ordered WhatsApp to put on hold its policy that bars third-party AI companies from using its business API to offer chatbots on the app. The agency has also started an investigation against the company to determine if the policy is anti-competitive.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Converge Bio raises $25M, backed by Bessemer and execs from Meta, OpenAI, Wiz
description: AI drug discovery startup Converge Bio raised $25 million in a Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with additional backing from executives at Meta, OpenAI, and Wiz.
author: Kate Park

title: Meta-backed Hupo finds growth after pivot to AI sales coaching from mental wellness
description: Hupo, backed by Meta, pivoted from mental wellness to AI sales coaching for banks and insurers, and secured a $10M Series A led by DST Global
author: Kate Park

title: Hands-on with Bee, Amazon’s latest AI wearable
description: We tried Amazon's new AI wearable Bee. It's not for pro users yet, but more features are expected this year.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Why Amazon bought Bee, an AI wearable
description: Amazon explains where its wearable Bee fits in and whether it will merge with Alexa.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Mark Zuckerberg says Meta is launching its own AI infrastructure initiative
description: Meta is ramping up its efforts to build out its AI capacity — Zuckerberg said the company intended to drastically expand its energy footprint in the coming years.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Anthropic announces Claude for Healthcare following OpenAI’s ChatGPT Health reveal
description: Anthropic's Claude for Healthcare is unveiled about a week after OpenAI announced its ChatGPT Health product.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Anthropic’s new Cowork tool offers Claude Code without the code
description: Built into the Claude Desktop app, Cowork lets users designate a specific folder where Claude can read or modify files, with further instructions given through the standard chat interface.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Amazon says 97% of its devices can support Alexa+
description: Amazon is counting on its Alexa footprint to help it gain traction in the consumer AI race.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google’s Gemini to power Apple’s AI features like Siri
description: Apple and Google have embarked on a non-exclusive, multi-year partnership that will involve Apple using Gemini models and Google cloud technology for future foundational models.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: A New Jersey lawsuit shows how hard it is to fight deepfake porn
description: A number of US laws have already banned deepfake pornography — most notably the Take It Down Act. But while specific users are clearly breaking those laws, it’s much harder to hold the entire platform accountable.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Harmattan AI raises $200M Series B led by Dassault Aviation, becomes defense unicorn
description: French defense tech company Harmattan AI is now valued at $1.4 billion after raising a $200 million Series B round led by Dassault Aviation, which is best known for making the Rafale fighter jet.
author: Anna Heim

title: Motional puts AI at center of robotaxi reboot as it targets 2026 for driverless service
description: Motional says it will launch a driverless robotaxi service in Las Vegas before the end of 2026.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: Google removes AI Overviews for certain medical queries
description: This follows an investigation by the Guardian that found Google AI Overviews offering misleading information in response to some health-related queries.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Indonesia and Malaysia block Grok over non-consensual, sexualized deepfakes
description: Indonesian officials said Saturday that they are temporarily blocking access to xAI’s chatbot Grok.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Google announces a new protocol to facilitate commerce using AI agents
description: Google said that merchants can now offer discounts to users directly in AI mode results
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI is reportedly asking contractors to upload real work from past jobs
description: An intellectual property lawyer says OpenAI is "putting itself at great risk" with this approach.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Indonesia blocks Grok over non-consensual, sexualized deepfakes

author: Anthony Ha

title: CES 2026: Everything revealed, from Nvidia’s debuts to AMD’s new chips to Razer’s AI oddities
description: CES 2026 is in full swing in Las Vegas, with the show floor open to the public after a packed couple of days occupied by press conferences from the likes of Nvidia, Sony, and AMD and previews from Sunday’s Unveiled event.
author: Morgan Little

title: How the Sleepbuds maker, Ozlo, is building a platform for sleep data
description: Ozlo Sleepbuds are going to have a big year, with new products, AI features, and more.
author: Sarah Perez

title: CES 2026 was all about ‘physical AI’ and robots, robots, robots
description: After years of chatbots and image generators, AI is finally leaving the screen. At CES 2026, that shift became impossible to ignore.  The annual tech showcase in Las Vegas was dominated by “physical AI” and robotics, from Boston Dynamic’s newly redesigned Atlas humanoid robot to AI-powered ice makers (yes, really). The companies in attendance clearly want consumers […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane

title: CES 2026: Follow live for the best, weirdest, most interesting tech as this robot and AI-heavy event wraps up
description: CES 2026, the annual consumer tech conference held in Las Vegas, is here. And lucky for you, we have TechCrunch editors and reporters on the ground to cover the news, scout out the interesting, weird, and relevant (and some not so relevant) tech, and of course the people working on it. AI has been at the center of most of the action, whether it's Nvidia and AMD's announcements or Amazon and Google's push for its use in the physical world. Follow our live updates as we share all the reveals and new hardware as it happens.
author: Kirsten Korosec, Sarah Perez

title: Meta signs deals with three nuclear companies for 6-plus GW of power
description: Two smaller companies, Oklo and TerraPower, along with Vistra, a large energy company, just signed agreements with Meta.
author: Tim De Chant

title: X restricts Grok’s image generation to paying subscribers only after drawing the world’s ire
description: Elon Musk's AI company has restricted Grok's controversial AI image-generation feature to only paying subscribers on X, after the tool invited heated criticism from across the world for letting users generate sexualized images of women and children.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Anthropic adds Allianz to growing list of enterprise wins
description: Anthropic announces its first enterprise deal of 2026 which includes building agents and for, and giving Claude code, to Allianz.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Governments grapple with the flood of non-consensual nudity on X
description: For the past two weeks, X has been flooded with AI-manipulated nude images, created by the Grok AI chatbot — and governments around the world are promising to take action.
author: Russell Brandom

title: OpenAI to acquire the team behind executive coaching AI tool Convogo
description: OpenAI is acquiring the team behind executive coaching AI tool Convogo in an all-stock deal, adding to the firm's M&A spree.
author: Rebecca Bellan
